body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Audio Unlimited presented its wireless floating speaker 'SPK-POOL' at CES 2010, which allows users to enjoy their music while relaxing in a hot tub, pool or any other water environment.

This fully waterproof speaker is powered by 900MHz PLL circuitry, which guarantees a strong, clear signal up to 150Ft away. The transmitter delivers a powerful signal through walls or any other obstacles.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
